A job starts when every condition is met. Checks spend nothing. A check profile gives up after 24 hours or 96 checks (wait-expired). A cancelled held job spent nothing while it waited. A check that cannot tell 5 times in a row ends the wait.

What can delay a job, and when it asks again
  • canary: Waiting for the operator model canary to finish
  • pause-window: In a pause window until its next scheduled check
  • size-never-fits: Its size fits no slot on the host; another host may take it
  • host-slot: the host has no free job slot
  • scope-folder: Its folder is busy with another run
  • scope-repo: Its repository's concurrent limit is full
  • scope-project: Its project's concurrent limit is full
  • endpoint: Every slot of model endpoint the model endpoint is taken
  • model-cooldown: No reviewed model is available; a model is cooling down. Asks again at its next scheduled check
  • model-window: No reviewed model is available; a model's dollar window is full. Asks again at its next scheduled check
  • host-budget: the host's budget has no room for it yet
  • bundle-profile: Waits for a host that serves its secret bundle profile
  • chained: Chained after the preceding run; starts when its folder is free
  • recovery-wait: Recovers run the preceding run, whose attempt is still running
  • wait-after: Held until its next scheduled check
  • wait-hold: Held on its wait check; asks again at its next scheduled check
  • wait-throttled: Its wait check waits for a free check slot
  • wait-supersede: Asks again whether the delivery holding its target still waits
  • wait-aborted: Its wait check was stopped by a restart or a cancel; asks again soon
  • wait-unclear: Its wait check answered in a way the worker cannot read; asks again at its next scheduled check
  • podman-restart: Waits for rootful Podman's service on the host to restart
  • netns-keeper: Waits for the network keeper on the host to settle
  • retry: Attempt the current attempt of the allowed attempts at its next scheduled check

Pause windows move to their end and reserve nothing. Retry backoff starts at 60 seconds and grows; scope and host slots ask after 5 seconds, endpoints after 7 seconds, host budget about every 9 seconds (keeping its place), and never-fits after 60 seconds for another host.
